selection: Piecewise-constant authored periods; legal-status changes are identity context only and local ratings do not inherit France-wide sports evidence.
limitations: All numeric ratings are project estimates with low confidence, not source measurements.
France-wide sports evidence is not inherited automatically.
No football federation membership or organised competition is inferred.
Administrative transitions are context only, not sports-performance evidence.
No rankings, titles or athlete outcomes are used to fit ratings.
